title: mfpvector: analysis code and molecular-dynamics run parameters for PFAS sorption to fluoropolymer microplastics
description:
Analysis scripts, molecular-dynamics driver and run parameters (packmol inputs and .mdp files), the umbrella-sampling protocol scripts with their WHAM profiles, bootstrap profiles and window histograms for PFOA on PTFE, PVDF, ECTFE and PE, the docking configuration, the Monte Carlo fluorine mass-balance script (fixed seed 20260710) and the per-replicate interaction-energy outputs supporting the manuscript “Fluorine content does not set simulated PFAS sorption to fluoropolymer microplastics: free-energy anchors and a bound on an unquantified organofluorine pool”.

Raw trajectories are not included. The GAFF2/AM1-BCC topologies, dry slabs, screen cells and all umbrella-window inputs of the PTFE, PVDF and PFOA systems rebuilt in October 2026 are archived (topologies/, slabs/, md_inputs/, archive/); those of the September 2026 screen were lost in a hardware failure, and the deterministic structure-generation and acpype protocol that produced them is archived under code/build/.

v1.0.1 adds: pullx/pullf series in the archive zips; a second slab realisation of all sixteen screen cells on a second, independently built slab for each polymer (data/realization2/, code/run_realization2.py, code/realization2_setAB/, code/realization2_setCD/); a charge-model test re-evaluating those trajectories with Gasteiger-Marsili and MMFF94 charges (code/charge_model/, data/charge_model/); solvent-accessible surface composition of the four archived slabs (code/sasa.py, data/surface_summary.json); surface partition coefficients from the PMFs (code/ksurf.py); and the revised figure scripts (code/make_fig1.py, code/make_fig4.py, which draws Fig. 3).
